senses.sense_definition: The theory that individuals create their own understanding and knowledge of the world through experiences and mental models.

examples.text: Many modern educators advocate for <w>constructionism</w> to help students build deeper connections with the material.

target_lang_translations.zh: 许多现代教育工作者提倡<w>建构主义</w>，以帮助学生与学习材料建立更深层的联系。

examples.text: The professor explained how <w>constructionism</w> differs from traditional methods of passive learning.

target_lang_translations.zh: 教授解释了<w>建构主义</w>与传统的被动学习方法有何不同。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种学习理论，认为个人通过经验和心理模型来构建自己对世界的理解和知识。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 教育学和心理学中关于知识获取的理论。

senses.sense_definition: A legal philosophy that emphasizes interpreting laws based strictly on their literal text rather than the perceived intent of the authors.

examples.text: The judge is known for her strict <w>constructionism</w> when reviewing constitutional amendments.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这位法官以在审查宪法修正案时坚持<w>严格解释主义</w>而闻名。

examples.text: Critics argue that <w>constructionism</w> ignores the social context in which laws were originally written.

target_lang_translations.zh: 批评者认为，<w>文本主义</w>忽视了法律最初制定时的社会背景。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种法律哲学，强调根据法律的字面文本而非立法者的意图来解释法律。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 法律解释中主张忠实于文本字面含义的学说。
法律解释中强调法律条文本身含义的学说。
